summary: Keep rich Desktop transcript rows measured correctly and make cold idle sends immediate, lossless, and duplicate-safe without weakening atomic delivery.

reactNativeIos.reason: React Native/iOS uses its own native transcript and already renders its durable pending and ambiguous outbox states; it does not import the Desktop TanStack virtualizer or Desktop transient message state.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android uses a Compose transcript backed by its Room outbox, which already owns pending, ambiguous, and acknowledged presentation and does not share Desktop renderer code.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The existing versioned atomic submission, canonical user.message event, and recovery contracts are unchanged; deliveryState is renderer-only and never crosses IPC or the remote protocol.

storageDataMigration.reason: Pending and recovery composer state remain renderer-only and no schema or stored message shape changes; existing profiles use the current migration path.

automated: npx vitest run tests/unit/desktop-pending-turn.test.ts tests/unit/draft-store-transaction.test.ts tests/unit/desktop-image-send-contract.test.ts tests/unit/message-list.test.ts tests/unit/chat-workspace.test.ts
notExercised: The user's live v0.8.35 profile and reported remote conversation are not opened or mutated; the failure sequence is exercised in a disposable real-Electron fixture.
Physical iOS and Android hardware are not exercised because neither native transcript nor outbox implementation changes in this patch.
